subject.title: fix(gateway): classify chat error kind via canonical failover reasons

question: Should the shipped `openclaw/plugin-sdk/infra-runtime` exports `ErrorKind` and `detectErrorKind` remain as deprecated compatibility API, or may this PR intentionally remove them?
rationale: Repository policy treats third-party plugin API as a compatibility exception, and the symbols are proven reachable from the latest shipped package; only maintainers can authorize a breaking removal.

options.title: Preserve deprecated exports
options.body: Keep the two public names as compatibility wrappers while migrating the gateway to canonical classification.

options.title: Approve versioned removal
options.body: Accept the breaking API change with explicit release documentation and plugin upgrade guidance.

recommendation.title: Preserve deprecated exports
recommendation.body: Keep the two public names as compatibility wrappers while migrating the gateway to canonical classification.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shipped classifier and have the strongest history-backed connection to the affected public and runtime surfaces.
